saw_lines: Meat delivery buyers worry about quality, freezing and the first box arriving fine, then they want one reason to trust it.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a new buyer decides whether the box is worth a click.
Your 14 of 24 copy ads open on the same membership line, so run two or three new angles from your meat and fish range against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: 14 of 24 copy ads open on the same membership line, so new buyers hear one reason to join and nothing else. Test two or three new angles from your wild fish and grass fed range against it.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a hesitant buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real number, like a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.
0 of 24 ads carry an offer, so a new buyer sees no reason to act today. Give them one reason, a first order offer or a bundle of two cuts, and open three new ads with it.
21 ads have run 60+ days, which is evidence they work. Build three more variations of the oldest winner, changing the cut shown and the first line, and keep the body copy that already runs well.
